newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industrialists see slight upturn in output.
newsitem.headline: Italy industrialists see slight upturn in output.

text.p: Average daily output rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4 percent month-on-month in April and 1.4 percent year-on-year, Italian industrialists' federation Confindustria said in a survey.
Output in March and April grew 0.7 percent against the first two months of the year, the survey added.
"This data underlines a tendency to overcome the most critical moment for industrial output, which was seen in the final months of 1996," Confindustria said.
On an unadjusted basis, industrial production rose 5.4 percent year-on-year in April, which had 21 working days in it, against 20 working days in April 1996.
Sales of industrial products rose an unadjusted 5.8 percent year-on-year in April, with sales abroad rising 6.5 percent and domestic sales up 5.2 percent, the survey said.
New orders rose 3.1 percent year-on-year, it added.

Over the first four months of the year, industrial output dropped 2.9 percent by comparison with the same period last year, while average daily production fell 0.7 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
